dedupe_keys.name: produccion de electricidad por fuente de combustible

description: Producción de electricidad por fuente de combustible is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by UPME. Información mensual sobre la producción de energía eléctrica en Colombia, desagregada por tipo de fuente de combustible. Incluye métricas de generación total, promedios, valores extremos y porcentaje de participación. La información es recopilada y procesada a partir de los datos operativos suministrados por XM y posteriormente analizada, modificada y adaptada técnicamente por la UPME. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher UPME. Its tags are upme, xm, generación, electricidad, energía. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2026-08-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
